SUGGESTION (handover_notifications._send): a reused packet file is never checked against the supplied summary; after a crash between the immutable packet write and the first deliveries insert, a later send with a changed summary for the same key delivers the stale packet while recording the new summary as SENT — verify packet['summary']==summary when reusing an existing packet file.
